summary: First-run testing of UNIB ONE app. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering auth, public endpoints, RBAC, availability/conflicts, external request wizard workflow (request->review->approved->confirmed w/ slot lock), anti double-booking with internal blocks, admin stats and content CRUD. All 26 backend tests passed. Frontend smoke tested: Home, Explore (search+filter), Facility detail (calendar, WhatsApp CTA), Request wizard (4 steps), UNIB Map page, Admin login (BPU) -> Dashboard render with KPIs, chart, recent requests. Data-testids present as documented.

minor.issue: Also accepts cookie 'access_token' as fallback but login endpoint doesn't set it. Not a bug - frontend uses Bearer as designed.

integration_issues.flow: Google Maps (UNIB Map page + Facility detail map)
integration_issues.issue: Google Maps JS API returns BillingNotEnabledMapError; overlay 'This page can't load Google Maps correctly.' appears on top of the map. Markers still render but map tiles show 'For development purposes only' watermark. Not a code bug - the API key REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in frontend/.env does not have Billing enabled in Google Cloud Console.

action_items: Enable Billing on the Google Cloud project associated with REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY OR restrict the key correctly so Maps JS loads on the production URL. Currently the map shows an overlay error to end users.

NOTE: The review_request referred to seeded slug 'unib-venue' but actual seeded slugs are e.g. 'gedung-serba-guna-gsg-unib', 'aula-fmipa-unib', etc. Tests were updated accordingly. If a canonical 'unib-venue' slug is desired, update seed_data.py.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: request_id generation uses `count_documents({}) + 1` which is race-prone under concurrent POSTs; consider atomic $inc counter or uuid to guarantee uniqueness (currently no unique index on request_id).
server.py delete_availability soft-cancels (status='cancelled') which is good, but delete_facility hard-deletes without checking active availability/requests referencing it — could orphan bookings.
server.py update_facility uses full-body replace (model_dump()) which forces client to send full object; PATCH-style semantics would be safer.

server.py CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' (from CORS_ORIGINS env). Modern browsers reject wildcard + credentials. Since frontend uses Bearer (not cookies) it's fine, but should tighten to explicit origin or drop allow_credentials.
get_current_user still reads cookie fallback but login never sets a cookie — dead code path.
seed_data: passwords for bpu/internal are hard-coded and only inserted if user missing; if admin changes password from UI, seeder won't overwrite (this is actually desired).

success_rate.frontend: smoke pass - all key flows load and render

test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md - all three roles verified working via /api/auth/login
seed_data_creation: No seed data added; used existing seeded facilities/users. Test data created during runs uses TEST_* prefix and is cleaned up in fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is stable and can be rerun with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Google Maps billing error is the only significant frontend integration issue observed. Frontend admin panel loads properly for admin_bpu with sidebar (Dashboard, Fasilitas, External Requests, Content & Stories, Internal & Block Schedule, Kalender Fasilitas). Have NOT deeply exercised admin CRUD flows via UI, nor Compare/Track pages, nor completing the 4-step wizard submission end-to-end via UI - those can be added if needed.
